feature_generation: For each source field, save only normalized dictionary terms satisfying the original alphanumeric-boundary matcher. Publication context is normalized title + publication types; affiliation context is normalized affiliations + institution country codes. The original input has no institution_country_codes column. Retain normalized-abstract nonempty flag. No text reconstruction or new literature retrieval.
verification_scope: Feature replay reproduces original scores, ordered branches and 25 stored output fields. It does not independently re-extract matches from the omitted third-party abstracts. The unchanged classifier can process a lawfully obtained original-format CSV with --input.
